rows.title: New Achievement! A Dungeon Crawler Carl panel with Matt Dinniman & Jeff Hays!
rows.description: Attention Dragon Con Crawlers! The creator (daddy) of the Dungeon Crawler Carl universe, Matt Dinniman, and the voice that brought the audio versions to life, Jeff Hays, are doing a special panel just for you! Come with your questions!

rows.title: Onesie Wednesday
rows.description: You've waited all year for DragonCon 2026 to happen. Worked hard on your cosplays, took days off from work, and even spent your tax return on a hotel. Why not hangout with us in your favorite Onesie on Wednesday and countdown to DragonCon? Haven't you heard? Wednesday's the new Thursday!

rows.title: How to Dragon Con with Kids
rows.description: Learn how to conquer Dragon Con with kids of any age: Safety tips, events you can't miss, the best quiet corners, & more. Kids under 16 must be with a parent/guardian; children 7+ must have badges.

rows.title: Kids Create: Draw Like a Dragon
rows.description: Join Art It Out Therapy for this fun, hands-on drawing activity. Kids learn to express emotions like Toothless and create wordless comics to tell a story through pictures. Kids under 16 must have a parent/guardian; children 7+ must have badges.

rows.title: Pulp High Fantasy
rows.description: From Weird Tales to Xena the Warrior Princess, Pulp Fantasy has always been with us.

rows.title: 2026 Film Track Kick-Off & Preview: The State of Film in 2026
rows.description: Welcome to the 2026 Dragon Con Film Track! This panel will officially kick off the Con with a preview of the panels & events attendees can expect over the weekend. We'll also discuss the state of Film in general, setting up many of the discussions and panels to be had in the coming days! Additional Panelists: Matt Smith

rows.title: What Is Filk? Welcome to the Filk Music Track
rows.description: Wondering what this track is all about? Here, we talk about what Filk Music is, what it was, and where it's going. Come meet some of our performers (as available).

rows.title: Diversity Track Kickoff: Why Representation Matters
rows.description: Start your Dragon Con journey here! Meet the Diversity Track team, and explore how representation is shaping the future of Fandom, media, and storytelling. Additional Panelists: Glenn Parris, Joy Stephens(Moderator)

rows.title: British Pub Trivia
rows.description: A classic pub quiz format covering British TV, film, music, history, and culture. Teams of up to five compete for bragging rights and the deep satisfaction of knowing things. No phoning a friend. No Googling. Absolutely no cheating. We're watching. Additional Panelists: Caro McCully(Moderator)

rows.title: Hidden & Forgotten Gems of Anime
rows.description: Tired of getting recommended the same Anime that you've already seen? Then, join us as we spotlight hidden gems, overlooked classics, and forgotten favorites that deserve a place on your watchlist. You might just discover your next favorite binge! Additional Panelists: Erik Norelus, Jess Merriman

rows.title: Aliens 40th Anniversary: Just Start Dealing with It
rows.description: A day at an Aliens anniversary panel is a day on the farm. (The panel only lasts an hour, not a day. We've been trained to deal with situations like this.) Additional Panelists: Shaun Rosado

rows.title: Now, Sit Right Back and You'll Hear a Tale: A Gilligan's Island Fan Panel
rows.description: Gilligan's Island is a tale of a show that became a cultural icon that is still loved by many today. Join fellow castaways as we all take a less-than-three-hour tour on a deep dive into the continuing lure of Gilligan's Island, the shipwrecked crew, and their adventures.

rows.title: Dragon Con History: How to Have 365 Days of Dragon Con
rows.description: Join DragonCon veterans and pillars of the community as they discuss what it means to live and breathe DragonCon all year round. Learn which social medias and chat groups to follow, Cosplay groups to watch for pictures, and everywhere in between. Additional Panelists: Amy Bray (501st), Bryan Saunders (Cosplay Medics), John Hinkle (Roswell Firelab), Jonelle Dawkins (Scraplanta), Laura Houser(Moderator), Ra'Neith (Freeside Makerspace), Shelby Kurland (Decatur Makers)

rows.title: Creatives & AI: Can We Co-Exist?
rows.description: Creatives often view AI as a threat—but is there room for ethical co-existence? This panel follows a non-technical creative's journey from anti-AI to cautious collaboration, exploring how AI can support productivity without compromising creativity, values, or artistic integrity. Additional Panelists: Fern the Geek(Moderator), Malcolm

rows.title: Digital Confluence: Where Creators & Fans Unite!
rows.description: Attention all digital media enthusiasts, creators, and fans! Get ready for Digital Confluence, the ultimate gathering where imagination meets innovation. Whether you're a YouTuber, Twitch streamer, TikTok star, or an avid fan, this event has something for everyone! Additional Panelists: Marc Leary

rows.title: Joystick Gamebar Presents: FREE Arcade Games!!!
rows.description: Come get your 'game on' at the pop-up from our friends at Joystick Gamebar, Atlanta's official retro arcade. Classic arcade cabinets & pinball machines are on FREE PLAY, located in the old Benihana space at the food court in Peachtree Center Mall. Full cash bar and food available for purchase.

rows.title: Joystick Gamebar Presents: FREE Arcade Games!!! Wednesday 6pm to 4am!
rows.description: Come get your 'game on' at the pop-up from our friends at Joystick Gamebar, Atlanta's official retro arcade. Classic arcade cabinets & pinball machines are on FREE PLAY, located in the old Benihana space at the food court in Peachtree Center Mall. Full cash bar and food available for purchase.

rows.title: Loyal Order of the Ribbon: Ribbon Reunion 2026!
rows.description: Come join the LOotRs as we welcome each other back to con! Catch up with fellow fans, collect and hand out ribbons, and get into the spirit of the con! Don't miss out on the excitement – see you there!

rows.title: Creatives & AI: Can We Co-Exist?
rows.description: Creatives often view AI as a threat—but is there room for ethical co-existence? This panel follows a non-technical creative's journey from anti-AI to cautious collaboration, exploring how AI can support productivity without compromising creativity, values, or artistic integrity.

rows.title: Digital Confluence: Where Creators & Fans Unite!
rows.description: Attention all digital media enthusiasts, creators, and fans! Get ready for Digital Confluence, the ultimate gathering where imagination meets innovation. Whether you're a YouTuber, Twitch streamer, TikTok star, or an avid fan, this event has something for everyone!

rows.title: Queer Cards: An Inclusive Intro to the History & Practice of Tarot
rows.description: Did you know tarot has a diverse, Queer history? Learn how Queer voices like Pamela Colman Smith and Rachel Pollack helped shape the modern tarot tradition, while we explore the origins and evolution of these iconic cards.

rows.title: Pokémon: Indigo League
rows.description: On Ash Ketchum's 10th birthday, he's ready to become a Pokémon Trainer! But winning Gym Badges is tougher than he thought—he got a Pikachu instead of a first Pokémon. Luckily, former Gym Leaders Brock & Misty offer help with a bevy of new Pokémon friends, including Bulbasaur, Squirtle, & Charmander.

rows.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
rows.description: Indiana Jones races against Nazis to find the Ark of the Covenant. Packed with adventure, humor, and iconic action sequences.

rows.title: Theater & Performing Arts Lovers Meetup
rows.description: Come hang out with the Dragon Con Theater & Performing Arts Lovers (unofficial) group for our annual meetup! We'll play theater games, catch up with friends, and maybe even break into song. Whether you're a lifelong drama kid or just love the performing arts, this is the place to be! Additional Panelists: Sarah Rose(Moderator)

rows.title: Magic in the Real World: Urban Fantasy World-Building
rows.description: Our panel of authors will discuss both the challenges & advantages associated with adding the supernatural to their creations that take place in a recognizable world. Additional Panelists: Carol Malcolm(Moderator)

rows.title: Bunny Hutch Party – Age Verification & Wristbanding
rows.description: Bring your valid ID card, driver's license, passport, military ID, permanent resident card, or acceptable tribal identification card to age verify/receive a wristband prior to Bunny Hutch Party. Note: This is not a 'fast pass,' but will speed the line to the Bunny Hutch.

rows.title: Bunny Hutch Party – Age Verification & Wristbanding
rows.location: Marriott Marquis Foyer Near Salon D doors
rows.description: Bring your valid ID card, driver's license, passport, military ID, permanent resident card, or acceptable tribal identification card to age verify/receive a wristband prior to Bunny Hutch Party. Note: This is not a 'fast pass,' but will speed the line to the Bunny Hutch.

rows.title: Star Wars: The Sith Rule of 2
rows.description: One Master, one apprentice—no more, no less. But in a galaxy driven by absolute ambition, the rules are meant to be bent. This panel will explore origins & development of the Rule of Two, hidden loopholes of Sith succession, & look at how dark side acolytes and Inquisitors fit into the grand design. Additional Panelists: Andrew Reeves, Brendan McBeth(Moderator), Darion Wilson, Evan Koenigs, Jannaea Adams

rows.title: Epic the Musical Sing-Along
rows.description: Come sing your favorite songs from Epic the Musical while watching the animatics. No vocal talent required – because everyone sings! Additional Panelists: Faye, Tanya Taylor

rows.title: Sherrilyn Kenyon & Friends: Costume & Book Signing Extravaganza!
rows.description: Dress as your favorite character, and join #1 NY Times bestselling author Sherrilyn Kenyon (and more than a dozen other of your favorite authors) for a fun signing party where Sherrilyn will be launching her newest title, Hell's Half Acre.

rows.title: Gatsby & Daisy Champagne Ball **EXTRA FEE EVENT**
rows.description: Step into the glamour of the Jazz Age with live electro-swing music, stunning Art Deco décor, and dazzling lights. Dance the night away, enjoy vintage-meets-modern elegance, and capture unforgettable memories at this Gatsby-inspired celebration. This an **EXTRA FEE Ticketed Event**

rows.title: No Way Out: A Fan Panel
rows.description: A Fan-driven discussion about the enigmatic Horror series, ranging from its mysteries to its mythology. What do we think is really going on? Additional Panelists: C. Damian Allen(Moderator), Courtenay Cody, Robyn McGlotten, Rocky Shields

rows.title: Georgia Speed & Surveillance Camera Update for 2026
rows.description: We'll take a look at both speed and surveillance cameras that have become ubiquitous on Georgia roads, their legality and constitutionality, and whether any legislative fixes are in the works to rein in these and other 'Policing for Profit' schemes.

rows.title: The Dark Knight Returns: 40th Anniversary
rows.description: 40 years ago, Frank Miller & Klaus Janson created the definitive Batman story unlike anything audiences have ever seen. We discuss the impact that the Dark Knight Returns had on Batman, DC Comics, and generations of Comics Fans over the last 40 years. Additional Panelists: Tony Barletta

rows.title: Comedy for a Cause
rows.description: Let's kick off Dragon Con with some stand-up comedy for an great cause! Bringing you a selection of the best comics local to Atlanta, this show will feature seven comics giving their best 10 minutes to raise funds for Hope Atlanta! Additional Panelists: K-Striggs, Melo Black, Michael Wurst, Renata Villarreal-Garza

rows.title: Writer's 2-Day Intensive Workshop with Jody Lynn Nye – Day 1 **EXTRA FEE**
rows.description: Day 1 of Jody Lynn Nye's two-day Intensive Writer's Workshop. **Extra Fee Workshop**

rows.title: Welcome to the 2026 Comics Track!
rows.description: We are back again to tell everyone why 2026 is going to be the most exciting year ever for Comic Book Fans at Dragon Con! Come hear about our exciting guests, the great Comics panels we have lined up, our NEW panel rooms on the 3rd floor of Mart2, & a reminder about how our Fast Pass helps you. Additional Panelists: David Sherman, Jami Jones, Jeremy Cottingham, Tony Barletta(Moderator)

rows.title: Dragon Con Swag 'n' Seek Kindness Panel & Group Meetup with Audience Q&A
rows.description: Come learn about Swag 'n' Seek's kindness movement! Meet other 'swaggers' & give or receive fun little gifts...just to lift your wings. Join us as we work to spread random acts of kindness throughout ALL of Dragon Con, even if you have to look high & low to see where they're hidden! Audience Q&A. Additional Panelists: Alex R Cannon, Francesca Genovese, Maria Potter

rows.title: Threats of the Modern World: A Survival Briefing
rows.description: From natural disasters to human?made crises, our world is breaking. Our experts break down real threats & practical survival strategies. This panel gives you a grounded look at navigating an unpredictable future. Learn how to stay alive or even thrive if there's a new Apocalypse Rising. Additional Panelists: Angela Smith, Jay Novella, Jonathan Sarge(Moderator), Melanie Waddell, Tabitha Fringe Chase

rows.title: Why Is It Squishy? JackMonkey FX Workshop – SFX Makeup: Session 2
rows.description: FX pro JackMonkey returns with an intimate 2?hour workshop on creating, applying, and painting silicone appliances. Step into the artist's chair and craft screen?ready effects with hands?on guidance that brings your imagination to life. Pre?registration required.

rows.title: Why Is It Squishy? JackMonkey FX Workshop – SFX Makeup: Session 1
rows.description: FX pro JackMonkey returns with an intimate 2?hour workshop on creating, applying, and painting silicone appliances. Step into the artist's chair and craft screen?ready effects with hands?on guidance that brings your imagination to life. Pre?registration required.

rows.title: Social Dance Lessons
rows.description: Want to learn some new dance steps? Swing, Salsa, Country, and more! Join our Social Dance instructors for group lessons in partner dancing! Additional Panelists: Alex Ferguson

rows.title: Lips-On Voice Acting Workshop w/ Jason Marsden **EXTRA FEE Workshop #1
rows.description: From the voice of Max in A Goofy Movie to Craig Boone in FallOut New Vegas & more, Mars will share his 40+ years of experience in the entertainment industry with this fun, immersive, 'lips-on' workshop covering what it's like, what it takes, & what to do as a professional voice artist. **EXTRA FEE

rows.title: WABE: Imagined Worlds, Real Nation – 40 Years of Fandom & America at 250
rows.description: WABE's Closer Look live broadcast will explore a powerful idea: how the stories we imagine have shaped the nation. From Science Fiction and Fantasy to Comics, Gaming, and Cosplay, fandom isn't just escapism—it's a creative engine for identity, resistance, innovation, and belonging. Additional Panelists: Pat Henry - President of Dragon Con, Rose Scott(Moderator)

rows.title: Muscle Nerdz Showdown
rows.description: The nations premier Cosplay/Bodybuilding competition is back again! Kick off the Con with masks, muscles, music, and more, as we crown our 2026 champions.

rows.title: Muscle Nerdz Showdown Pre-Judging
rows.description: If you are pre-registered for the Muscle Nerdz Showdown, please join us for judging. Contestants and one handler only, please.

rows.title: Doctor Who Werewolf
rows.description: The universe trembles! Enter the TARDIS for an immersive game of hidden identities. A secret Dalek agent lurks, spreading insidious chaos. You must expose the traitor before the Doctor's last hope is exterminated! Master this social deduction challenge in groups of ten. The future is yours. Additional Panelists: Anthony Williams, BewitchedRaven(Moderator)

rows.title: Learn to Read Hangul
rows.description: Wanna read K-Pop lyrics & K-BBQ menus like a pro? Created by King Sejong to be the world's most logical alphabet, learning Hangul is easy! Decode food favorites like bulgogi or tteokbokki, or spot the names of BTS, Stray Kids, & BLACKPINK. No language fluency required – it's just pure decoding fun! Additional Panelists: Natasha O'Loughlin(Moderator)

rows.title: Page to Stage Costume Contest Prejudging
rows.description: Prejudging for the Page to Stage Costume Contest. Characters from all forms of stories come to life! We welcome al characters from any book, comic, manga, graphic novel, or more. Pre-registration for this may be done via Dragon Con's website under Things to do –> Programming –> Contests.

rows.title: Coloring for Charity
rows.description: Chill out while you color to sounds of relaxing Lo-Fi Nerdy beats & raise money for this year's charity, Hope Atlanta. 7pm–Midnight.

rows.title: Dragon Con Wrestling
rows.description: The best independent wrestlers from all over the United States showcase their fearsome skills for three exciting hours. If you STAY ready to RUMBLE, you don't have to GET READY TO RUMBLE!!! With Special Guest WWE's Victoria!

rows.title: Opening Ceremonies for Dragon Con 2026
rows.description: Black Sheep Ensemble will welcome you as we celebrate the beginning of our 40th Dragon Con! Meet our Guests of Honor, and hear about our exciting happenings for this year's Dragon Con! Additional Panelists: Black Sheep Ensemble, Pat Henry

rows.title: Dragon Con Newbies Discussion with Q&A
rows.description: First Dragon Con, eh? Or, maybe you still find yourself confused or overwhelmed, even if it's your 2nd or 3rd Dragon Con. Savvy Convention attendees will share tips & tricks to navigate this amazing pop-culture event. Audience Q&A. Additional Panelists: Kim McGibney

rows.title: Dragon Con Newbie Walking Tours
rows.description: Want to get the lay of the land & find your way around the Dragon Con Campus? Did you know there is even a food court? Meet others new to Dragon Con by touring with veteran Con-goers. Guided groups leave every 30 minutes. The last tours of the day will depart at approximately 3:30PM. Additional Panelists: Kim McGibney

rows.title: YA PowerPoint Party
rows.description: Join the YA Lit Track to kick off the 40th Dragon Con with a PowerPoint party, where you could get 5 minutes to share on your favorite topic. Feel free to send us slides in advance at yalit@dragoncon.org! Additional Panelists: Heidi Tandy, Natalie Simpson(Moderator)

rows.title: '80s Prom! '80s Prom! Back to the '80s: 40 Years of Fandom
rows.description: Dance into Dragon Con's 40th with a totally rad '80s Prom! Neon vibes, iconic hits, and late?night magic collide – so let's dress to impress, and party like it's 1987!

rows.title: Video Game Karaoke
rows.description: Video Game songs – sung with friends in key or not – returns to Dragon Con! Additional Panelists: Bo Cheimis(Moderator)

rows.title: GameCube Night
rows.description: Immerse yourself in the world of GameCube and Gameboy Advance, brought to life by colossal, fully operational consoles! Enjoy Multiplayer action with several GameCube Classics, and compete to grab a limited spot in the Final Round: a Super Smash Bros Melee contest!

rows.title: Encounter at Galleria 2-3: Star Trek Meetup
rows.description: Celebrate the kick-off of the convention with your fellow Trekkies in a casual meetup as the Track volunteers batten down the hatches and get everything shipshape in accordance with Starfleet regulation. Additional Panelists: Leo Visentin(Moderator)

rows.title: RPGFamiliar LIVE!
rows.description: Join RPGFamiliar LIVE once more as they play Tales of the Valiant! Come watch our adventurers roll on a Wild Magic table of the audience's creation, as they attempt to uncover the cause of wild magic surges deep in the mines of Direcliffe! Additional Panelists: Cristobal Sanchez, Crystal Le @crystalleplays, Emma @emmalsatt, James @ttrpgjames, Meadow @howdylovedarlingm, Mitchell Windom @Borris_v_w

rows.title: SciTrack Mixer
rows.description: Come meet the Science Track, and talk with us about volunteering, presenting on Science Track panels – or let us know your favorite Science topic! Additional Panelists: Vaughan James

rows.title: What Is Scenic?
rows.description: We'll be going over how to get into Scenic as a career, a bit of its history, and the basic tools and techniques for beginners. Do you want to learn the skills it takes to change your view of reality? We'll explore how imagination transfers to real life and define each step of the way. Additional Panelists: Elizabeth Johnson(Moderator), Marty Smith(Moderator)

rows.title: How to Build an Underwater Robot
rows.description: Ed Larson discusses the basic requirements to build an underwater Robot. Topics include buoyancy, displacement, power requirements, water tightness, and control.

rows.title: Dragon Con 40th Anniversary: Puppetry Track Memories
rows.description: Past guests, volunteers, and attendees can share their favorite Puppetry Track memories in celebration of 40 years of Dragon Con!

rows.title: MSFM Onesie Mixer
rows.description: So many fandoms...so little time! At the Thursday night MSFM Onesie Mixer, you can meet & hang out with fans of all the different shows in our track as we get to know each other with fun & games! Come break the ice in your favorite onesie, costume, or comfy-casual Con couture & chill with us. Additional Panelists: James Henson, Karen Henson(Moderator)

rows.title: Directed Energy Weapons, Fact vs Fiction, History & Potential- NSDM Lecture
rows.description: Laser, high-powered microwave, and particle-beam weapons: fiction yesterday, becoming reality today. Fact vs. fiction: what is the current state-of-the-art and the near-term potential? Capt. Mark McDonagh, USN/ret., physicist with 12 years' experience at the Naval War College, on NSDM staff.

rows.title: Intro to International Relations Lecture
rows.description: What is international relations & why do we care? It forms foundations of what, why & how things happen in the international system, explains primary actors, major competing forces & why foreign policy isn't the same as international relations. Dr. Craig Greathouse, Professor of Political Science.

rows.title: Bunny Hutch Contest Pre-Judging
rows.description: Are you pre-registered for the Bunny Hutch Costume Contest? If so, please join us for judging. Contestants and one handler only please.(Mature Audience) Additional Panelists: Avera Cosplay(Judge), Lisa Bregent(Moderator)
